page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; a decorative woodcut border above the heading; no margin notes. Running head at top faint (show-through/partial). Signature mark "*.ij" at foot right.

main_text.head: CLARISSIMIS ET AMLPISSIMIS viris, Dominis Consulibus & Senatoribus urbis Amsterodamensis Dominis suis plurimùm obseruandis.
main_text.p: QVIN sit immensum Dei erga genus humanum beneficium, vera sacrosancti Euangelij restitutio, quæ nostris hisce temporibus à Patre luminum, cùm aliis populis, tum præsertim toti Hollandiæ oblata est, nemo, non dico Christianus, sed sanus mente diffiteri, Viri præstantissimi, potest.Nam si terræ in qua habitamus fæcunditas, si agrorum vbertas, si

page.notes: Large woodcut initial "Q" in the paragraph opening; read as "QVIN" with the initial Q joined to "VIN". Faint show-through of the reverse page is present in the upper margin and right side and is omitted. The header "EPISTOLA" in faint type at the top is show-through and omitted. Line "potest.Nam" reads with no space after the period as printed. Long s rendered as s throughout.
